act: Emergency Response Support System (Ministry of Home Affairs)
title: Single national emergency number 112
plain: 112 is India's single emergency number for police, fire, ambulance and women's helplines, run under the Ministry of Home Affairs' Emergency Response Support System (ERSS).
notes: Older numbers (100, 101, 108, 181) are being integrated into 112; integration varies by state.

act: Tele-MANAS (Ministry of Health and Family Welfare)
title: National Tele Mental Health helpline 14416
plain: Tele-MANAS is a free, 24x7 government mental-health helpline. Call 14416 or 1-800-891-4416 to talk to a trained counsellor in your language.
notes: Launched 10 October 2022 under the National Tele Mental Health Programme.
